newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar called to open little changed.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar called to open little changed.

text.p: CSCE world sugar was called to open mostly unchanged Thursday, but prices could continue to erase recent gains, dealers said.

They said the heavy open interest in the benchmark October contract makes the market vulnerable to a washout. As of early Tuesday, open interest stood at 105,870 lots. Traders said liquidity in the contract is even greater following the sharp gains made on Tuesday.
Nearby support was pegged at 11.40 cents a lb for October sugar, followed by 11.25 to 11.20 cents.
Wednesday, benchmark October ended down 0.10 cent at 10.49 cents after trading from 11.58 to 11.45 cents. The rest finished unchanged to 0.06 cent weaker.
An estimated 19,746 lots changed hands on the day.
LIFFE white sugar futures were mixed in thin Thursday trade, with activity focused on the spot October contract. At 0847 EDT/1247 GMT, October was trading 20 cents higher at $328.20.
